title: SECI opens bids for green ammonia under SIGHT Tranche II
dek: The second green ammonia round asks producers to quote a delivered price for fertiliser plants in four states. Bids are due on 15 November.
body:
The Solar Energy Corporation of India (SECI) has opened bids for the second green ammonia round under the SIGHT programme. Producers must quote a delivered price per kilogram for fertiliser plants in Gujarat, Maharashtra, Odisha and Andhra Pradesh.

Bids are due on 15 November. As in the first round, SECI will sign a 10-year purchase agreement with each winner and pay the SIGHT incentive for the first three years. The tender document, the RfS, sets a ceiling price for each plant.

## What changes from Tranche I

The first round set prices between ₹51.80 and ₹55.75 per kg across its first four auctions. This time SECI has added a delivery-performance clause: producers who miss more than 10% of committed volume in a year lose part of the incentive.

> "This round rewards producers who can deliver, not just those who bid lowest." Procurement head at a fertiliser company, speaking on condition of anonymity

Bidders H2 India spoke to said the bigger question is power: most plants will need round-the-clock renewable supply, which pushes up the cost of storage.
